sources.excerpt: If borrowed liquidity prevents a normal exit, follow [Exit an illiquid vault in kind](/developers/earn/tutorials/in-kind-redemption/) to preview and transfer the vault's positions.
sources.assertion: Normal underlying exit depends on borrowed liquidity; in-kind positions are not guaranteed whole-slice underlying realization.

entries.rationale: The exact deployed lending-position slice has no published whole-slice maximum realization horizon. Reviewed issuer product/risk documents, legal terms and document archive, protocol withdrawal docs and exact verified source disclose liquidity dependence, not a bounded repayment SLA. Instant branding, atomic execution when liquid, and current idle balances do not prove immediate realizability of the complete position. This is a noncustodial protocol vault, not an attested fund with a regulator-mandated redemption term.
